evaluation_mode: Offline deterministic engines; Gemini generation, embeddings and OCR disabled and guarded
positive_class: fraudulent; legitimate and borderline are negative
flag_definition: FLAG_FOR_REVIEW or REJECTED (legacy engines: also any emitted red flag). NEEDS_MORE_INFORMATION is never counted as a fraud detection in primary metrics.

input_paths.baseline: AIVerifierService fallback with lexical top-5 retrieval
input_paths.candidate_v1: top-5 lexically retrieved chunks (its frozen protocol)
input_paths.candidate_v2: every uploaded document, extracted in full with rag.extract_document_text
